title: Towel Stand With 4 Pivoting Swing Arms 49-Inch Solid Brass Freestanding | Antique Copper | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
short_title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand 49-Inch, Antique Copper
description:
Keep towels organized and within reach without drilling into your walls in Antique Copper, which brings warm, reddish-brown tones with natural variation, perfect for rustic or craftsman-style bathrooms. This freestanding 4 pivoting swing arm towel stand creates flexible hanging space for bath towels and hand towels, with arms that swing for easy access and spacing.

Highlights:
- Antique Copper creates an inviting, organic feel
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stay stable on the floor: large, weighted base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Built for enduring daily use: crafted from solid brass materials to resist rust and corrosion
- Coordinate your look: part of the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection with multiple designer finish options

Specs & Installation:
- Product type: Freestanding towel stand (swing arm style)
- Arms: 4 pivoting swing arms
- Material: Solid brass
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 9.25 in.
- Assembly: Some assembly required
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
